mesh_convergence.method: Final 0.2 s means; both CL,total and CD within 1% across the candidate and at least two finer comparable meshes in the same near-wall family. Each confirming mesh must have no larger nominal outer/surface/zone/first-layer size and no fewer prism layers, at the same total prism thickness and unchanged geometry/domain. Cell count alone does not establish directional refinement. Prefer the resolved low-y+ family when wall-model sensitivity is material. Final wall-field and geometry review remains required.
mesh_convergence.timing_method: Median and mean elapsed wall seconds between consecutive physical steps in the accepted final 0.2 s window. Mean includes recorded checkpoint/report overhead; median reduces its influence. Initialization and final exports outside this window are excluded. Other CPU activity can affect the observed times.
